PowerShell($routes = @\('/', '/api/pricing', '/deepseek-api-cost-calculator', '/ai-model-price-comparison', '/zh', '/zh/deepseek-api-cost-calculator'\); foreach \($route in $routes\) { $url = "http://localhost:3000$route"; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output "$route $\($response.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "$route ERROR $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; exit 1 } })

PowerShell($routes = @\('/', '/zh', '/api/pricing', '/deepseek-api-cost-calculator', '/ai-model-price-comparison'\); foreach \($route in $routes\) { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$route" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; "$route $\($r.StatusCode\)"; if \($route -eq '/api/pricing'\) { $json = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; "source=$\($json.source\) count=$\($json.count\) hasDeepSeekV4Flash=$\([bool]\($json.models | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'deepseek-v4-flash' }\)\)" } })
